statut_salon.aide: Where the bot posts its state, refreshed every 5 minutes

export.texte: {n} setting is in the file below. || {n} settings are in the file below.
export.rappel: To put them on another server: `/config` with the `file` option. Channels and roles don't travel — they don't exist over there.

import.opt_fichier: An exported settings file, to apply it here
import.resume: **{n}** setting will change. || **{n}** settings will change.
import.pourquoi_ignores: Channels, roles and categories in the file are skipped: their IDs belong to the other server and point to nothing here.
import.rien: Nothing to import. {ignores} pointed at channels or roles from the other server.
import.expire: This import has expired, or isn't yours. Send the file again.
import.trop_gros: This file is too big to be a settings file.
import.telechargement: I couldn't read the file. Try again.
import.pas_json: This isn't a settings file: it doesn't contain valid JSON.
import.version_inconnue: This file comes from a version I don't know ({version}). Export it again from an up-to-date server.
import.format_invalide: This file has the right shape but no settings inside.
import.valeur_invalide: The value of setting `{nom}` doesn't match what it expects. Nothing was imported.
